comments.text: I am greatly saddened as I look at Guam today.   Our family lived and worked there 1980-1986. Lastly we had a Miss World crowned while we lived there.  We have experienced several typhoons while there.  Attending village fiesta was something we did as I was a teacher in a couple of villages and were invited.  We have experienced the island from one end to the other end and even inland .  We have enjoyed dinner at the Government House……we loved our 6 years living both in Talofofo and Windward Hills.  I took flying lessons there and enjoyed landing amid military planes.  Your video did saddened us as you do not pronounce many of the words correctly……we loved our time there❤️❤️❤️I do have two degrees from UOG too!  When I was teaching, one of my student teachers was the daughter of the Superintendent…….yes we know a lot about Guam and have great memories!
